title.zh: Balancer终止运营：请在10月30日前退出你的资金池 - CryptoTicker
title.en: Balancer Winddown: Exit Your Pools by October 30 - CryptoTicker

current_state.zh: Balancer 关停已获治理投票批准（BIP-928 通过，BIP-929 分叉被否），流动性池照常运行至 10 月 30 日，之后转为仅提现，11 月 30 日 V3 Vault 暂停，2027 年 5 月底起 BAL 持有者可销毁 BAL 按比例获取财库资金。
current_state.en: Balancer's shutdown is approved by governance vote (BIP-928 passed, BIP-929 fork rejected); pools operate normally until Oct 30, then withdrawal-only, V3 Vault pauses Nov 30, and from late May 2027 BAL holders may burn BAL for pro-rata treasury redemption.

updates.title_zh: 【Balancer 社区投票通过关停提案，分叉提案未获通过】
updates.title_en: 【Balancer 社区投票通过关停提案，分叉提案未获通过】
updates.what_changed_zh: BAL 持有者投票通过 BIP-928 有序关停提案，分叉提案 BIP-929 被否决；确认时间线：10 月 30 日前流动性池照常运行且提款开放，10 月 16 日为合作方申请 V3 池延长至 11 月 30 日的截止日，10 月 30 日起转为仅提现且漏洞赏金结束，11 月 30 日 V3 Vault 暂停，2027 年 5 月底起可销毁 BAL 按比例获得财库资金；tetuBAL 持有者获相当于锁定资金 50% 的 BAL。
updates.what_changed_en: BAL holders voted to approve BIP-928 for orderly shutdown and rejected the BIP-929 fork proposal; confirmed timeline: pools run normally with withdrawals open until Oct 30, Oct 16 deadline for partners to request V3 pool extension to Nov 30, withdrawal-only mode and end of bug bounty from Oct 30, V3 Vault pause Nov 30, and BAL burn-for-treasury redemption from late May 2027; tetuBAL holders receive BAL equal to 50% of locked funds.
updates.current_state_zh: Balancer 关停已获治理投票批准（BIP-928 通过，BIP-929 分叉被否），流动性池照常运行至 10 月 30 日，之后转为仅提现，11 月 30 日 V3 Vault 暂停，2027 年 5 月底起 BAL 持有者可销毁 BAL 按比例获取财库资金。
updates.current_state_en: Balancer's shutdown is approved by governance vote (BIP-928 passed, BIP-929 fork rejected); pools operate normally until Oct 30, then withdrawal-only, V3 Vault pauses Nov 30, and from late May 2027 BAL holders may burn BAL for pro-rata treasury redemption.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Balancer's BAL holders voted to approve BIP-928 for the protocol's orderly shutdown while rejecting the BIP-929 fork proposal, setting a timeline of normal pool operation until Oct 30, withdrawal-only mode thereafter, V3 Vault pausing Nov 30, and treasury redemption through BAL burning from late May 2027.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Balancer's BAL holders voted to approve BIP-928 for the protocol's orderly shutdown while rejecting the BIP-929 fork proposal, setting a timeline of normal pool operation until Oct 30, withdrawal-only mode thereafter, V3 Vault pausing Nov 30, and treasury redemption through BAL burning from late May 2027.
